decision: GO for ONE and ONLY ONE execution of V26C_J15_FRESH_35D_POST_MISMATCH_REFIT.
granted_by: the architect (Codex), on the conclusion of the J15-readiness audit of 2026-08-27. This record does not grant itself: it transcribes a decision taken elsewhere and pins by exact hash the five artefacts the architect verified.

reason_for_revision.finding: rev1 recorded, under architect_independent_audit.selftest.environment, that the architect's independent audit ran with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX both ABSENT. That was a FALSE ATTRIBUTION: the architect ran the suite AND the preflight with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, with only PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX absent.
reason_for_revision.how_the_error_arose: the executor recorded the environment of ITS OWN verification runs and attributed it to the architect's. The architect had never stated it. It was an inference presented as a fact about someone else's run.
reason_for_revision.what_was_conflated: two DISTINCT facts that must never be merged: (a) the environment in which the architect's independent AUDIT was run, and (b) the environment the frozen FIT must be executed in. They are different, and this record separates them explicitly.
reason_for_revision.scope: an ATTRIBUTION defect in one field. It touches no pin, no argv, no gate, no restriction and no artefact. The decision itself, the five pins and the frozen argv are carried over unchanged.
reason_for_revision.rev1_status: PRESERVED BYTE-IDENTICAL and superseded. It was NEVER CONSUMED: no fit was started under it, no j15_runs, lock, staging directory or sentinel was ever created, and the leaf does not exist.

environment.applies_to: both the suite and the preflight of the architect's independent audit
environment.stated_by: the architect; NOT inferred by the executor

gate.composition: 16 = the preserved J11 binding subset, + 1 = j14_increment_rmse_decreases on the whole 854-row J14 block

no_j15_artifacts_before_go.verified: immediately before this record was written

architect_independent_audit.do_not_confuse: this environment describes the AUDIT. The environment the FIT must run in is a different thing and is stated in frozen_argv.environment below.

pinned_artifacts_note: the first four paths are relative to the validation root; the fifth is relative to the repository root. All five were re-verified on disk immediately before this record was written.

frozen_argv.environment: the FIT must be executed with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE and PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX BOTH ABSENT from the environment. This is NOT the environment of the architect's audit, which set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; the two facts are distinct and are deliberately kept apart in this record.
frozen_argv.why_absent_for_the_fit: the suite disables bytecode writing itself, in-process, before it imports the runner. Requiring the variables to be absent proves that guarantee holds without external help.

preflight.expect: exit 0, verdict GO, 0 blockers, 23 pinned sources, writes nothing

leaf.born_invalid: a TECHNICAL_INVALID marker is written into staging BEFORE the rename and removed only as the last write, after the post-commit verification passes.

not_authorised_by_this_record: a second execution of the fit
an autonomous retry after a failure
a probe of the frozen argv after a successful run
changing production, FSM v3, the morphology corridor, the reward, sigma, the SEA or the C++ plugin
modifying any existing prereg, authorization, receipt, leaf or report
on_failure: the evidence is preserved fail-closed and the stage STOPS for the architect. No deletion, no repair, no second attempt without a further GO record.

closing_rule.rule: at the end of the J15-fit phase a dedicated user report must be written in reports/user/, and it must be audited by the architect BEFORE J16 begins.
closing_rule.also_standing: probes of a frozen argv after a successful run are FORBIDDEN

self_consistency.why: a record that hashed itself, or that hashed a set including itself, would invalidate its own value in the act of being written. This record carries NO digest of itself and NO digest of any set containing it. It does pin the SHA-256 of rev1, which is a different file and therefore stable.
self_consistency.how_to_verify_this_record: recompute the SHA-256 of each of the five pinned artefacts and of rev1, and compare. That check is stable and reproducible.
